question_or_proposition: Whether the 1/Week 12-Hour Composite monitoring specified for Total Dissolved Solids, Discharge (*6) measured at Outfall 001 is applicable only during periods when effluent is discharged from Outfall 001, or applies throughout the permit term regardless of whether discharge occurs.
required_context: Footnote *6 (Outfall 001 measurement location and geometric-mean reporting of weekly values)
SECTION A authorization language for discharge from Outfall 001
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page 4, Section part_i, Total Dissolved Solids, Discharge row
notes: The nominated row pairs report-only effluent limits with an explicit 1/Week monitoring frequency. Resolving discharge-conditionality changes whether monitoring was required during no-discharge periods (Purpose B) and whether absent results reflect conditional non-requirement versus missing required monitoring evidence (Purpose C). Purpose A is unaffected because all limit columns are Report with no numeric standard.
